revision_policy: Record the physical PCB silkscreen, fitted MCU, oscillator, external Flash and connector routing before HIL; a reference-board document is not an observed board identity

clock.verification: Configured board profile; oscillator, voltage and PLL behavior have not been measured on hardware

memory.allocation_policy: Linker data, BSS, heap and stack use only the contiguous 192 KiB main SRAM. ADDRAM and TCM are declared regions without default allocation, startup initialization or DMA-reachability claims

storage.erase_operation: GD32F470 independent 4 KiB page erase through official fmc_page_erase(), not 128 KiB sector erase
storage.geometry_source: GD32F4xx User Manual Rev3.3 section 2.3.4; FMC_PEKEY, FMC_PECFG.PE_EN and 4 KiB-aligned page address, FMC_CTL.SN=0
storage.policy: Validate physical density and linker partition fences. Product serializes the port and reserves a maintenance window; same-bank Flash instruction/IRQ stalls and power-fail recovery require hardware evidence

timebase.policy: Reserved for platform timestamps and deadlines, not an application timer. IRQ observation is not start-bit capture. Keep the timer running and service its overflow before a full 32-bit wrap

debug.probe: Record the actual probe and fixture; no populated probe is assumed

console.electrical: 3.3 V MCU UART; record the actual host adapter and connector routing in the hardware fixture

spi.implementation: Polling controller with bounded task-serviced transaction queue

rs485.reason: The stock profile has no onboard RS485 transceiver or active DE allocation

optional_external_profile.requires: Explicit configuration and a recorded external transceiver/DE wiring fixture

external_flash.policy: SPI4 wiring is implemented; no external NOR storage partition, JEDEC identity, protocol driver or physical fitted part is claimed without verification

safe_outputs.leds: Preload PD7 low before output mode
safe_outputs.spi: Preload PF6 CS high before output mode and before the external clock transition
safe_outputs.rs485: Optional PB1 DE is preloaded low only when the external RS485 profile is explicitly enabled; the stock profile leaves it unallocated
safe_outputs.industrial_actuators: No industrial actuator pins are configured or claimed safe

provenance.scope: Exact GD32F470ZGT6 identity, Cortex-M4F, 1 MiB Flash, 512 KiB SRAM and LQFP144
Official part memory domains and peripheral alternate functions
Memory/identity, independent page erase section 2.3.4 and TIMER1 width in timer chapter 18
Official GD32F4xx firmware SDK and startup; locked original archive/source hashes and licenses
First-party Liangshan Pi reference-board documentation; compare the physical oscillator and PCB with this profile before HIL
W25Q64 SPI4 PF6 CS/PF7 clock/PF8 MISO/PF9 MOSI AF5 reference-board wiring
